b=/home/hesham/gova/.local/direct-agent-recovery/20260831T200000Z/direct-src
rm -rf packages/local-agent-core/src/direct

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

crypto=Path('packages/local-agent-core/src/direct/crypto.ts')
s=crypto.read_text()
s=s.replace('privateKey: { key: privateKeyPem, format: "pem", type: "pkcs8" },\n    publicKey: { key: peerPublicKeyPem, format: "pem", type: "spki" },','privateKey: createPrivateKey(privateKeyPem),\n    publicKey: createPublicKey(peerPublicKeyPem),')
s=s.replace('const signature = sign(null, buffer, { key: privateKeyPem, format: "pem", type: "pkcs8" });','const signature = sign(null, buffer, privateKeyPem);')
s=s.replace('return verify(null, buffer, { key: publicKeyPem, format: "pem", type: "spki" }, signature);','return verify(null, buffer, publicKeyPem, signature);')
s=s.replace('directIdentityTlsCertPath()', 'directIdentityCertPath()')
if 'createPrivateKey' not in s.split('\n',20)[0:20]:
    s='import { createPrivateKey, createPublicKey } from "node:crypto";\n'+s
crypto.write_text(s)

execution=Path('packages/local-agent-core/src/direct/execution.ts')
s=execution.read_text()
if 'import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";' not in s:
    s='import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";\n'+s
s=s.replace('child.stdout.on("data",', 'child.stdout?.on("data",')
s=s.replace('child.stderr.on("data",', 'child.stderr?.on("data",')
s=s.replace('const applyRes = runCapture("git", ["apply", "--whitespace=nowarn", "-"], targetDir, payload.patch);','const applyRes = spawnSync("git", ["apply", "--whitespace=nowarn", "-"], { cwd: targetDir, input: payload.patch, encoding: "utf8" });')
s=s.replace('err.conflictingLock', 'err.holder')
execution.write_text(s)

index=Path('packages/local-agent-core/src/direct/index.ts')
s=index.read_text().replace('export * from "./transport-types";\n','')
index.write_text(s)
